# `MC_knlDefTimer`

Initialize a timer object with its callback.

## Prototype

```c
void MC_knlDefTimer(MCTimer *tm, TIMERCB cb);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlDefTimer
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tm` | Caller-owned timer storage. |
| `cb` | Callback invoked when a scheduled timer expires. |

### Ownership

The caller retains the timer storage and must keep it valid while scheduled.
